info.title: Mayur-Maheta API
info.description: Multi-Tenant Project Management SaaS Backend API (Modules M1.1 Setup & Foundation, M1.2 Authentication, M1.3 Super Admin - Company Management, M1.4 Team & Seats)

adminRefreshCookie.name: art
adminRefreshCookie.description: Super Admin Refresh Token httpOnly cookie (path: /api/v1/admin/auth)

reason.example: Permanent erasure requested under data regulations
Diagnosing broken project permission issue for customer

message.example: User limit reached (10/10). Please upgrade your plan to add more users.

get.description: Public health endpoint returning system status, uptime, and version.
Verifies database connectivity and checks whether the MongoDB replica set is operational.

post.description: Authenticates a tenant user using email and password. On success, issues a 15-minute access token in JSON and sets an httpOnly refresh token cookie (rt). Account lockout occurs after 5 failed attempts.

403.description: Account not activated, user removed, or company suspended/deleted

423.description: Account locked due to excessive failed attempts

post.description: Rotates the presented refresh token from the `rt` cookie and issues a new access token and rotated refresh token cookie.

401.description: Token invalid, expired, revoked, or reuse detected

403.description: Origin not allowed or company suspended/deleted

post.description: Revokes the refresh token family associated with the active session cookie `rt` and clears the cookie. Idempotent.
Revokes all active refresh token families for the authenticated user and increments tokenVersion, invalidating all existing access tokens.

get.description: Returns current user information, company details, and role verified directly from the database.

post.description: Sends a password reset email if the account exists and is active. Anti-enumeration: always returns a generic 200 response.
Validates the single-use reset token and updates the user password. All active sessions are revoked.

422.description: Password does not meet security policy

post.description: Activates an invited user account (status: INVITED -> ACTIVE) and sets their password using the invitation link token.

200.description: Account activated and password set successfully

422.description: Password does not meet security policy

post.description: Updates the authenticated user password after verifying current credentials. Revokes all active sessions.

422.description: New password does not meet policy or matches current password

post.description: Authenticates a Super Admin. When ADMIN_OTP_ENABLED is true, dispatches a 6-digit email OTP and returns a challengeId. When disabled (dev/test), issues tokens directly.

200.description: OTP challenge initiated or login successful

423.description: Account locked due to repeated failed attempts

post.description: Validates the 6-digit OTP against the login challenge. On success, issues a 10-minute admin access token and sets the `art` cookie.
Generates and sends a new OTP for the active challenge, voiding the previous one. Enforces 60-second cooldown and max 3 resends.

429.description: Cooldown active or maximum resend limit reached

post.description: Rotates the admin refresh token from the `art` cookie and issues a new admin access token.

401.description: Token invalid, expired, revoked, or reuse detected

post.description: Revokes the current admin session family and clears the `art` cookie. Idempotent.
Revokes all active sessions for the Super Admin and increments tokenVersion.

get.description: Returns current Super Admin profile and status verified from the database.

post.description: Sends password reset link to Super Admin email. Always returns generic success response.
Resets Super Admin password using the one-time reset token.
Activates an invited Super Admin account and sets their initial password.

200.description: Password set and account activated successfully

post.description: Updates Super Admin password and revokes all active sessions.
Creates a customer company, its Owner user, and sends a set-password link atomically.

409.description: Company name or owner email already exists

get.description: Search, filter, and paginate through customer companies.
Returns complete company details, user counts by status, and recent audit logs.

patch.description: Update profile information (legal name, phone, address, notes, support access).

put.description: Modify name or email of the Owner while their status is INVITED.

200.description: Owner updated and fresh invite sent

post.description: Re-issues the set-password link to an invited Owner.

put.description: Upgrade or downgrade plan, seatLimit, storageLimitMB.
Suspends an active company and immediately blocks user access.
Re-activates a suspended company and restores user access.
Marks company DELETED, revokes all active sessions, and starts retention period.
Restores a soft-deleted company back to ACTIVE before retention expires.

409.description: Retention period expired or invalid transition

post.description: Permanently erases all tenant collections, identities, and sessions without waiting for retention.
Issues a time-limited, read-only tenant token to view company as Owner for support.

get.summary: Get Audit Logs for Specific Company
get.description: Retrieves audit entries for the specified company.
Lists all Super Admin platform accounts.

post.description: Invites a new Super Admin team member.

put.description: Disables a Super Admin and revokes all active sessions.

409.description: Cannot disable last active Super Admin

put.description: Re-enables a disabled Super Admin account.
Clears failed login count and unlock date.

post.description: Re-sends the set-password invite to an invited Super Admin.

get.description: Search, filter, and paginate through tamper-resistant platform audit entries.
Returns real-time aggregated company counts, seat and storage utilization, near-limit alerts, and growth trends.
Returns seat meter overview, user count breakdown, and capabilities of caller role.
Available to all authenticated roles for assignee pickers, mentions, and collaborator selection.
OWNER and ADMIN only. Retrieves paginated team members with filtering by role and status.

post.description: Atomically reserves a seat, creates user in INVITED state, creates login identity, and sends set-password email. If previous user of same company was REMOVED, reactivates them.

402.description: Seat limit reached for company plan

get.description: OWNER and ADMIN only. Returns detailed information including invitedBy, lock state, and removal metadata.

patch.description: OWNER and ADMIN only (subject to role hierarchy: OWNER > ADMIN > MEMBER).

put.description: OWNER only. Promotes or demotes between ADMIN and MEMBER. Increments tokenVersion immediately.
OWNER and ADMIN only (hierarchy enforced). Updates platform identity, revokes active sessions, and notifies old and new email addresses.
Atomically frees the seat, sets status REMOVED, releases login identity, invalidates sessions, preserves all historical tasks/data. Owner cannot be removed.
OWNER and ADMIN only (hierarchy enforced). Clears failed login attempts and lockout timestamp.

post.description: Reissues a fresh set-password link for an INVITED user without consuming extra seats. Cooldown enforced.

429.description: Resend cooldown or hourly limit exceeded

post.description: OWNER only. Re-authenticates owner with current password, promotes an ACTIVE ADMIN to OWNER, and demotes caller to ADMIN.

409.description: Target user is not an active admin

patch.description: Available to all roles to edit their own name, mobile, and designation.

get.description: OWNER and ADMIN only. Query audit logs of team actions (invites, removals, updates, ownership transfers).

post.description: SUPER_ADMIN only. Compares denormalized seatsUsed with actual active+invited users and fixes drift if needed.
